name: octopus-live-worker
description: Octopus Live relay on Cloudflare Workers: calls the Octopus API once a minute and shares live electricity + gas with all your devices.

OCTOPUS_API_KEY.description: Your Octopus Energy API key (starts with sk_live_). Find it at octopus.energy > Personal details > API access.

RELAY_TOKEN.description: A password your devices add to the address (?token=...). Use a long random string.

POLL_SECONDS.description: Seconds between Octopus requests. 60 keeps you safely under Octopus's rate limit.
